categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Matches the Mining label and modifies BlockAssembler and BlockTemplateManager tracking for getmininginfo.
categories.rationale: Fixes an informational bug where getmininginfo can report block stats from the fee estimator's background templates rather than actual mining templates. The author notes that 'the mempool fee estimator builds its own templates with BlockAssembler, so getmininginfo can report the fee estimator\'s template instead of the last mining template,' while also removing global state without lock annotations.
